doc:
Platform module for the MySocial network
 Manages social media platforms and their timelines

bootstrap_init.doc: Bootstrap initialization function - creates the platform registry

create_platform.doc: Create a new platform and transfer to developer

platform_version.doc: Get the version of a platform

borrow_platform_version_mut.doc: Get a mutable reference to the platform version (only for upgrade module)

registry_version.doc: Get the version of the platform registry

borrow_registry_version_mut.doc: Get a mutable reference to the registry version (only for upgrade module)

add_to_treasury.doc: Add MYSO tokens to platform treasury

mark_platform_governance_proposal_implem.doc: Mark a platform-linked governance proposal as implemented; pay the proposer the implementation pool.

delegate_vote_on_platform_governance_pro.doc: Platform-linked registry: delegate vote; on council rejection, the pool is forfeited to this platform’s treasury.

finalize_platform_governance_proposal.doc: After community voting, finalize a platform-governance proposal; on failure, pool to this platform’s treasury.

finalize_platform_governance_proposal_an.doc: Same constraints as [`governance::finalize_proposal_anonymous`]: non-`entry` so decryption key vectors are valid arguments.

grant_moderator_permission.doc: Grant a single extension permission to a platform moderator

grant_all_moderator_permissions.doc: Grant all extension permissions to a member (full platform moderator)

revoke_moderator_permission.doc: Revoke a single extension permission from a platform moderator

add_moderator.doc: Add a moderator with all extension permissions (developer-only convenience wrapper)

remove_moderator.doc: Remove a moderator entirely from the platform moderators group

block_wallet.doc:
Block a wallet address from the platform
 Allows platform developers/moderators to block wallets using the platform address as the blocker
 This enables platforms (shared objects) to block user wallets

unblock_wallet.doc:
Unblock a wallet address from the platform
 Allows platform developers/moderators to unblock wallets using the platform address as the blocker

toggle_platform_approval.doc:
Toggle platform approval status (requires PlatformAdminCap only)
 Optional reasoning can be provided to explain the decision

delete_platform.doc:
Delete a platform (requires PlatformAdminCap only)
 Can only delete platforms that are NOT approved
 Optional reasoning can be provided to explain the deletion

is_valid_category.doc: Validate that a category string matches one of the allowed categories

join_platform.doc:
Join a platform - establishes initial connection between wallet and platform
 Checks for blocks before allowing the join and verifies platform is approved
 Works with wallet addresses only, no profile required

leave_platform.doc: Leave a platform - removes the connection between wallet and platform

is_approved.doc: Get platform approval status from registry

has_joined_platform.doc: Check if a wallet address has joined a platform

is_developer_or_moderator.doc: Backward-compatible helper: true if developer or has any extension permission

get_platform_by_name.doc: Get platform by name from registry

get_platforms_by_developer.doc: Get platforms owned by a developer

wants_dao_governance.doc: Check if platform wants DAO governance

governance_registry_id.doc: Get platform's governance registry ID if available

update_platform_governance.doc:
Update governance parameters for this platform's governance registry
 Can only be called by the platform developer

airdrop_from_treasury.doc:
Airdrop tokens to multiple recipients from the platform treasury
 Can only be called by platform developer or moderator with treasury permission

assign_badge.doc:
Assign a badge to a profile - can only be called by platform admin/moderator
 This is the primary entry point for badge assignment

revoke_badge.doc:
Revoke a badge from a profile - can only be called by platform admin/moderator
 This is the primary entry point for badge revocation

add_moderator_register.doc: When adding a moderator to a platform, register them with the profile module

remove_moderator_unregister.doc: When removing a moderator from a platform

create_platform_admin_cap.doc:
Create a PlatformAdminCap for bootstrap (package visibility only)
 This function is only callable by other modules in the same package

PlatformAdminCap.doc: Admin capability for Platform system management

ModeratorsGroupTag.doc: Derivation key for the per-platform moderators permission group

PlatformBlockAdmin.doc: Permission to block/unblock wallets on behalf of the platform

PlatformTreasuryAdmin.doc: Permission to airdrop from the platform treasury

PlatformContentModerator.doc: Permission to moderate posts and comments on the platform

PlatformPromotionAdmin.doc: Permission to manage promoted posts and view payouts

Platform.doc: Platform object that contains information about a social media platform

wants_dao_governance.doc: Whether the platform wants DAO governance

governance_registry_id.doc: ID of governance registry if created

PlatformRegistry.doc: Platform registry that keeps track of all platforms

platforms_by_name.doc: Table mapping platform names to platform IDs

platforms_by_developer.doc: Table mapping developer addresses to their platforms

platform_approvals.doc: Table mapping platform IDs to their approval status (admin-controlled)

ModeratorPermissionsGrantedEvent.doc: Emitted when one or more moderator permissions are granted

ModeratorPermissionsRevokedEvent.doc: Emitted when one or more moderator permissions are revoked

ModeratorRemovedEvent.doc: Emitted when a member is fully removed from the moderators group

UserJoinedPlatformEvent.doc: Event emitted when a user joins a platform

UserLeftPlatformEvent.doc: Event emitted when a user leaves a platform

TokenAirdropEvent.doc: Event emitted when tokens are airdropped from the platform treasury

TreasuryFundedEvent.doc: Event emitted when tokens are added to platform treasury
